morphology.pattern_note: 作为外来称号整词记忆，不拆分为马来语词缀；规范马来语拼写 syogun 中的 sy 表示 /ʃ/。

senses.zh_definition: 将军：日本历史上掌握政权的最高军事统治者；规范马来语拼写为 syogun。
senses.en_definition: A shogun, the supreme military ruler of historical Japan; the standard Malay spelling is syogun.
senses.ms_definition: Panglima tertinggi tentera Jepun yang memegang kuasa pemerintahan; ejaan baku bahasa Melayu ialah syogun.
senses.nuances: 这是日本历史称号，不泛指普通武士，也不等同于天皇。下列规范搭配采用 syogun；所提供的 shogun 保留为查询词形。释义据 DBP 条目改写。[DBP：syogun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=syogun)

dual_scenarios.context: 历史出版物 / 拼写说明
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam penerbitan ini, istilah shogun ditulis sebagai syogun mengikut ejaan bahasa Melayu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 本出版物按照马来语拼写规范，将 shogun 写作 syogun。
dual_scenarios.en: In this publication, shogun is written as syogun in accordance with Malay spelling.

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah baca pasal shogun tu. Dia maharaja ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah membaca tentang syogun itu. Adakah beliau seorang maharaja?
messages.zh: 我已经看过那个将军的介绍了。他是天皇吗？
messages.en: I've read about that shogun. Was he the emperor?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Bukanlah. Shogun tu pemerintah tentera, bukan maharaja.
messages.ms_standard: Bukan. Syogun ialah pemerintah tentera, bukannya maharaja.
messages.zh: 不是啦。将军是军事统治者，不是天皇。
messages.en: No, he was a military ruler, not the emperor.

etymology.historical_story: The title comes from Japanese shōgun, meaning a supreme military commander. In its historical political use, it abbreviates a longer title associated with commanding campaigns against peoples described as barbarians. Malay standardizes the spelling as syogun. Remembering it as a specific Japanese office helps distinguish the military ruler from both the emperor and ordinary samurai. [DBP: syogun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=syogun)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 sho-gun 与日语“将军”连起来记；写规范马来语时，把开头 sh 换成 sy：syogun。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 这是历史称号，语体中性；讨论历史人物时可使用 beliau 表示尊重。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于日本史、博物馆说明和相关影视讨论；正式马来语正文采用 syogun。
